target_digest_format: SHA-256 of UTF-8 bytes with LF line endings
draft_method: Machine-assisted Portuguese-to-English draft, followed by editorial and technical review. Translation tooling is not a repository dependency.
limitations: Pattern scanning and approved hashes do not independently prove semantic accuracy. AWS labs were not executed.
intentional_exceptions: Original PNG artwork, MIT license, index.html, and deployment workflow are byte-identical to source.
Original promotional URLs and proper names remain unchanged.
Portuguese source paths and question text occur only in audit JSON for traceability.
